raw.chosen: Separated mirror-root artifacts from per-Syncer runtime layout
raw.reasoning: Scoped children are real remote subtrees; creating digests or skills beneath them turns root-only local artifacts into remote content. All .relay-only writers now use one runtime initializer, while root setup retains the full layout.

retrospective.summary: Prevented scoped child Syncers and state writers from creating root-only digest/skill artifacts; added E2E absence and runtime-directory assertions; full vet and Go suite pass.
